clauses.heading: 1. Customer Declaration
clauses.text: I possess a valid Driving Licence, am medically fit to ride, will obey all traffic rules, will not ride under influence, will wear a helmet, and take responsibility for any traffic fines.

clauses.heading: 2. Customer Responsibilities
clauses.text: Return the scooter in same condition, inform owner immediately of accidents, do not tamper with GPS or battery, and keep vehicle safely parked.

clauses.heading: 3. Accident Clause
clauses.text: Immediate intimation to owner within 1 hour. Do not admit liability without authorization. Damage responsibility determined based on policy & facts.

clauses.heading: 4. Traffic Challans & Theft
clauses.text: Customer pays all traffic challans and fines. In case of vehicle theft, immediate police complaint and GPS tracking activation is mandatory.

clauses.heading: 5. Prohibited Uses
clauses.text: Racing, stunts, illegal activities, carrying hazardous materials, commercial courier overload, and riding outside permitted city limits.
